correctness.rationale: For all integers \(n\ge1\) and all integer configurations, the signed two-time potential forces each strict complete-graph comparison to reverse in an initially two-periodic state, and tied pairs cannot emerge from unequal pairs without destroying two-periodicity. Ordered level blocks of sizes \((a_i)\) therefore have independent integer gaps \(1\le d_i\le a_i+a_{i+1}-1\). Multinomial labellings and a rank-two transfer recurrence establish the exact exponential generating function. The positive-transfer-matrix Perron comparison proves the unique dominant simple pole and the asymptotic. Self-contained direct simulations and independent exact rational series checks passed on package paths; neither is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Counting periodic points modulo the inherent global-shift symmetry is a natural canonical invariant of the original synchronous diffusion system. The all-order EGF supplies exact primitive-two orbit counts and a nontrivial factorial-exponential growth constant. Two transfer coordinates compress a weighted ordered-composition census; this goes beyond a narrow handpicked finite case and is potentially useful for comparing recurrence populations under graph changes. The significance is confined to initial periodic points rather than attraction basins.
